card.name: Spray words in inhaler priming instructions
card.fires_on: The word spray (or its pieces, like spr, aeros, canister) in aerosol inhaler and spray-can directions, especially priming steps such as 'shaking well before each spray'.

modes.label: Priming sprays
modes.description: The word spray ending the phrase about shaking before each spray when priming an inhaler.
modes.example: release 2 sprays into the air away from the face, shaking well before each<< spray>>. 2.3 Dose Counter

modes.label: Partway through aerosol words
modes.description: Pieces of aerosol, canister, dispense or sprays inside inhaler or foam instructions.
modes.example: Avoid spraying in the eyes or face when priming beclomethasone dipropionate HFA inhalation<< aeros>>ol.

card.writes: It adds little that is clear; a weak lean toward aerosol-like and product-name word starts such as combust, Bomb and Aeros.
card.plain: It lights up on spray-related words in directions for using inhalers and spray cans.
